newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X shares halted until further notice.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X shares halted until further notice.

text.p: Shares in Bre-X Minerals Ltd will be halted until further notice, the Toronto Stock Exchange market surveillance department said on Wednesday.
Bre-X shares did not trade on Wednesday. They closed on Tuesday at C$15.50. TSE officials declined to comment further on the trading halt.

Bre-X released a statement earlier saying there appears to be a "strong possibility" that the potential gold resources on its Busang gold project in Indonesia have been overstated due to invalid samples and assays of those samples.
Freeport-McMoRan Copper & Gold Inc said earlier on Wednesday its tests of the Busang II site indicate insignificant gold amounts.
